title: LLMOps run manifest
description: Single source of truth for one pipeline run, stored at s3://<bucket>/runs/<run_id>/manifest.json. Agents read it first and append their stage entries; the harness driver verifies claims before recording them. The iteration counter drives the remediation loop (max 3).

run_id.description: llmops-<UTC timestamp>-<6 hex chars>, assigned by start_pipeline

trigger_source.description: Which of the pipeline triggers started this run

plan.description: Optional run plan written by the llmops_orchestrator conductor (plan.json contents): per-stage params, cost estimate, quality bar.

iteration.description: Remediation-loop counter; 0 on first attempt, incremented per finetune remediate cycle, escalates to human when it would exceed 3

stages.description: One entry per pipeline stage/task keyed by stage name (e.g. data-prep, finetune, eval, deploy, monitor).

outputs.description: S3 URIs of produced artifacts, verified to exist by the driver. Empty array is VALID (empty-but-valid is distinct from missing).

evidence.description: Agent's one-paragraph proof of what was verified

model_id.description: e.g. the DeepSeek-R1 Bedrock model id

adapter_uri.description: S3 URI of the trained QLoRA adapter
